name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Dale's weight is immediately below the angler who landed the Catfish.

Cody's weight is immediately next to the angler who landed the Bluegill.
The angler who landed the Carp's weight is at least 4 lb more than Dale.
Cody's weight is higher than both Mabel and the angler who landed the Perch.
The catch with 11 lb does not belong to the Pike Family.
